info.name: Steam Games API
info.description:
Complete REST API collection for the Steam-style games dashboard backend.

**Base URL:** `http://localhost:5000`

**Auth:** Most protected routes require a Bearer JWT token.
1. Call `POST /api/v1/auth/login` to get a token.
2. Copy the `data.token` value.
3. In Postman, go to the collection → Variables and set `token` to the copied value.

**Test Credentials:**
- Regular User: `test@example.com` / `secret12`
- Admin User: `admin@example.com` / `adminpassword123`

**Response Shape:**
```json
{ "success": true, "message": "...", "data": { ... } }
{ "success": false, "message": "...", "error": "..." }
```

variable.description: JWT token obtained from login or register response (data.token)

item.name: 🔐 Auth
item.description:
User registration, login, logout, and profile management.

**Rate Limit:** Register and Login are limited to 10 requests per 15 minutes.

request.description:
Create a new user account. Returns the user object and a JWT token.

**Note:** The `role` field is blocked from being set to `admin` via this endpoint. All registered users get `role: user` by default.

**Required fields:** name, email (valid format), password (min 6 chars)

Login with email and password. Returns user object + JWT token.

Copy `data.token` from the response and paste it into the collection `token` variable.

Login as the admin user. Returns JWT token with role: admin.

This token is required for all `/api/v1/admin/*` routes and admin-only game CRUD operations.
Stateless logout — the server has no session to destroy. The client should delete the JWT token locally. Returns a confirmation message.

Get the profile of the currently logged-in user.

**Requires:** Bearer JWT token in Authorization header.

Update the name or email of the logged-in user. Password changes are handled by the change-password endpoint.

**Requires:** Bearer JWT token.

Change the password for the logged-in user. Old password is verified before updating.

**Requires:** Bearer JWT token.
**Fields:** oldPassword, newPassword (min 6 chars)

item.name: 🎮 Games
item.description: Browse, search, sort, and manage Steam-style game listings.

query.description: Sort by: rating | price | downloads | releaseDate | popularity | title

request.description:
Get a paginated list of games with optional filters.

**Sort options:** `rating`, `price`, `downloads`, `releaseDate`, `popularity`, `title`
Returns a single randomly selected game from the database.
Get a single game by its AppID. Replace `100001` with an actual AppID from your seeded data.
Check if a game with the given AppID exists in the database. Returns a boolean.
Get a summarized view of a game (title, price, rating, platforms, genres).

Add a review to a game. Requires a valid JWT token.

**Fields:** text (string), rating (number 1-10)
Update your own review. Replace `:reviewId` with the actual review `_id`.
Delete your own review. Replace `:reviewId` with the actual review `_id`.
Soft-delete (archive) a game. The game is hidden but not removed from the database. Any logged-in user can archive.
Restore a previously archived game. Any logged-in user can restore.
Create a new game. **Requires admin role JWT token.** Login as `admin@example.com` to get the correct token.
Full replacement of a game document. **Requires admin role JWT token.**
Partial update of a game. Only include the fields you want to change. **Requires admin role JWT token.**
Permanently delete a game by AppID. **Requires admin role JWT token.**

item.name: 🛡️ Admin
item.description:
Admin-only routes. **Requires** a JWT token from an account with `role: admin`.

Login with `admin@example.com` / `adminpassword123` to get the correct token.

**Errors:**
- `401 Unauthorized` — No or invalid token
- `403 Forbidden` — Logged in but not an admin
